description: Mouth interior and lips [REG-03], [DOC-07]: teeth [MTH-01], gums [MTH-02], tongue [MTH-03], lip colour and moisture.

defaults.provisional: The mouth shaders are not written yet: the value is normalised to 0..1 and the default is a placeholder until the shaders and reference renders calibrate it.

parameters.provisional: An ivory placeholder: no measured tooth colour reference exists in the project yet.
parameters.description: Base colour of the teeth near the gum line, linear Rec.709; the incisal edges are lighter and more translucent.
How much light passes through the enamel, strongest at the biting edges; low values give opaque, chalky teeth.
Wear of the biting edges: flatter, shorter, slightly chipped incisors with more visible dentine; 0 is unworn.
Yellow-brown staining of the teeth, strongest between them and near the gums; 0 is clean.

parameters.provisional: No reference data yet: the axis is an authored delta of the tooth meshes and the value its weight (+-3).
parameters.description: Makes the front incisors longer and larger relative to the other teeth; negative values make them smaller.

parameters.provisional: No reference data yet: the axis is an authored delta of the tooth meshes and the value its weight (+-3).
parameters.description: Makes the canines longer and more pointed; negative values make them shorter and blunter.

parameters.provisional: No reference data yet: the axis is an authored delta of the tooth meshes and the value its weight (+-3).
parameters.description: Makes the premolars and molars broader; negative values make them narrower.

parameters.provisional: A pink placeholder: no measured gum colour reference exists in the project yet.
parameters.description: Base colour of the gums, linear Rec.709.

parameters.provisional: No reference data yet: the axis is an authored delta of the gum mesh and the value its weight (+-3).
parameters.description: Moves the gum line down over the teeth (more gum shows in a smile); negative values pull it back, showing longer teeth.

parameters.provisional: A pink placeholder: no measured tongue colour reference exists in the project yet.
parameters.description: Base colour of the tongue, linear Rec.709.
Whitish coating on the back and middle of the tongue; 0 is a clean pink tongue.

parameters.provisional: A placeholder: lip colour will be derived from the skin pigment model [SKN-11] once it exists; this is an override base.
parameters.description: Base colour of the red of the lips, linear Rec.709.
Wetness of the lips: high values give glossy lips with a bright moist strip at the lip line, low values dry, matte lips.
